container_synth — DRIVE granular op

• Data kinds: scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.container_synth(fill_frac: 'float', surface_tilt_deg: 'float' = 0.0, rows: 'int' = 200, cols: 'int' = 160, supersample: 'int' = 8) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import granular; granular.container_synth(fill_frac: 'float', surface_tilt_deg: 'float' = 0.0, rows: 'int' = 200, cols: 'int' = 160, supersample: 'int' = 8) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("container_synth"))

Usage

Synthesizes the powder coverage seen from the side inside a transparent container (flat surface, tilt allowed). Ground truth = fill_frac.
